thesis: Understanding involves distinct capacities, especially transfer across changed conditions, rather than fluent intuition alone.
role: Connect mathematics, AI and collective tools with accountable understanding.

ideas.statement: Prediction, mechanism, intervention and transfer differ; a law understood well maps dependencies and limits.
AI equation discovery depends on supplied vocabulary and data; opaque predictions warrant external testing and partial explanations, not unlimited authority.
Tools and conceptual changes extend human competence without guaranteeing eventual complete transparency.
